title: 3I/ATLAS anomalous composition

tellings.quote:
nickel go together. So now you
have something that is nickel and not iron.

plain: 3I/ATLAS, an object from outside our solar system that was seen passing through in 2025, appears to contain nickel without the iron that normally goes with it. The researcher Kevin Knuth says this, drawing on the astronomer Avi Loeb, and explains that in nature the two metals are usually found together. If that is right, the object's makeup would be very unusual for a natural rock.
